custom_fields.label: Allow Employees to Check In Themselves
custom_fields.description: Requires a User linked to the Employee record.

custom_fields.label: Auto Close Open Check-ins at Shift End
custom_fields.description: An employee who never checks out gets an OUT written at the shift end, marked Closed Automatically.

custom_fields.label: Ask for a Reason on Check Out
Verification
custom_fields.description: Every check-in is scored out of 100 and the score is kept on Clock Attempt. Each check below that fails subtracts from it.

custom_fields.label: Require a Passkey
custom_fields.description: One passkey per employee, registered on their own phone. Replacing it requires an HR reset.

custom_fields.label: Refuse Check-in Without a Passkey
custom_fields.description: If unchecked, a missing passkey is only flagged.

custom_fields.label: Check the Network
custom_fields.description: Match the address the request came from against Clock Network.

custom_fields.label: Check the Location
custom_fields.description: Match the position the browser reports against Clock Place and the Shift Location's own radius. Requires Allow Geolocation Tracking.

custom_fields.label: Network and Location
custom_fields.description: Either accepts a check-in that passes one of the two. Both requires each of them.

custom_fields.label: Refuse Below Score
custom_fields.description: Check-ins scoring below this are refused and no Employee Checkin is written. The failing checks are shown to the employee.

custom_fields.label: Flag Below Score
custom_fields.description: Check-ins scoring between this and Refuse Below Score are written, and marked Flagged for review.

custom_fields.label: Ask for a Photo
custom_fields.description: Captures a frame from the camera at check-in. Choosing an existing file instead is not allowed.

custom_fields.label: Delete Photos After (Days)
custom_fields.description: Set to 0 to keep them indefinitely.

custom_fields.label: Learning
custom_fields.description: Only check-ins that passed another check are counted. Nothing learned widens who may check in.

custom_fields.label: Learn New Networks
custom_fields.description: Propose a Clock Network when enough employees check in from an address the site does not know.

custom_fields.label: Learn New Locations
custom_fields.description: Propose a Clock Place when enough employees check in from just outside an existing one.

custom_fields.label: Include Personal Networks and Locations
custom_fields.description: Also propose networks and locations belonging to a single employee, such as a home.

custom_fields.label: Confirmation Threshold
custom_fields.description: Number of distinct employees, and of check-ins each, before a Proposed network or location becomes Confirmed.
